artifact_role: participant evidence — the coordinator's own record of how it ran the programme, not independent review

routing.note: Every phase ran deterministic prework before any model call. Prework supplied exact evidence paths, computed counts and enumerated candidate sets, so no dispatched session spent tokens rediscovering what git, a parser or a schema could settle.
routing.task_population_note: STATE014-001, upheld. The 23-task figure was a snapshot taken before POSTW1-PACKET-014 was created. Current population is 24. The 12 Codex-primary figure is likewise pre-packet; current is 13.

deterministic_controls_built.discipline: Each checker was written test-first with a control asserting every check can be made to fail, then run against the real artifact and mutated once per check. Mutation results on real data: gap trap 7/7, agent-ready matrix 7/7, split design 7/7, retirement 6/6, retrospective 6/6, wave2 specify 7/7, design contracts 5/5, DAG 5/5, BIUs 6/6.
deterministic_controls_built.limitation_found: The design contract checker PASSED an artifact containing four material defects that independent verification then found. A checker establishes that fields are present and decisions are not deferred; it cannot establish that a design is right.

Three were caught by dispatched sessions disputing the Director rather than by the Director. The two logic errors in terminal_state and next_task would both have misreported programme state to the Founder.

coordinator_errors_found_and_corrected.correction_note: ORCH014-001, upheld. The original record reported count 8 while listing 8 surface-read and 4 logic errors, which reads as a total and is not one. Neither 8 nor 12 is asserted as exhaustive; these are the errors that were found, not the errors that exist.

blocking_policy: Amendment §4: a decision affecting one branch halts that branch only. All 7 were marked critical_path false after checking that phases 8-13 did not require them. next_task and terminal_state were both fixed to honour that distinction rather than stalling globally or reporting false completion.
